|---|---|---|

| `index_points` | function | Gather points/features by index. points: (B, N, C), idx: (B, S) or (B, S, K) -> (B, S, C) or (B, S, K, C). |
| `farthest_point_sample` | function | Iterative farthest point sampling. xyz: (B, N, 3) -> centroid indices (B, npoint). |

| `sample_and_group` | function | FPS + ball-query grouping + local (centroid-relative) coordinates. |
| `sample_and_group_all` | function | Group ALL points into a single region (used for the final SA layer). |
